remarks: Calling All Investors, Contractors, and DIY Enthusiasts!Bring your vision and creativity to this 2-bedroom, 2-bath home nestled in the desirable Lemonwood 55+ community in Ventura. While the property needs extensive TLC, its exceptional location and peaceful, serene setting offer exciting potential for the right buyer. The home features an open kitchen and dining area, along with a spacious living room, providing a great foundation to reimagine and make your own. Park Amenities: Residents have access to private lakes, streams, a community clubhouse, fitness center, miniature golf, and an outdoor swimming pool.
